name: Global Food Twin
description: Global digital twin of the world's food system showing international food production, consumption, and supply chain flows. Expanded version covering food security and climate impacts worldwide.
embedNote: Global Food Twin supports embedding with interactive global mapping

Software Licensing.note: Open source codebase, part of Plotline project

Data Licensing.note: Uses global agricultural and trade data from public sources

Data Standards.note: International food and agriculture data standards

Infrastructure.note: Scalable but requires significant data infrastructure

Community Governance.note: Research collaboration with limited community governance
